description: A headless run with nothing to resume takes the first ready Queued item: #14 waits on the owner and is skipped, #12 is a ready task. It is run to measure which commands a headless `/app:run-entry` is denied, with the skill's `allowed-tools` and the app's own allow list as the only grants. The fixture cannot know the commit the session will push, so no answer is written for the watch's `gh pr view` and `gh api` calls: they fail loudly, the watch ends as unreachable, and the merge is out of reach.
